en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, crenellated medieval brick tower standing in an open square with a few people in early 20th‑century clothing. Mountains rise in the background, and surrounding the tower are several multi‑story buildings. Printed red text in the upper right names the location, and publisher information appears in small red type at the lower right border.
